findings.description: All 61 hook file paths in settings.json resolve to existing files on disk.
findings.evidence: Verified all 61 unique hook .cjs paths: 61 found, 0 missing.
Checked all hooks across 7 event types (UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, SessionEnd, PreCompact, Stop).

findings.description: 9 agent files on disk are NOT registered in config.yaml. These are domain-router sub-routers that exist as .md files but lack config entries (no model assignment).
findings.evidence: Config: 111 agents, Disk: 119 agent .md files. Missing from config: domain-router-ai-ml, domain-router-arch-data, domain-router-backend, domain-router-infra, domain-router-mobile, domain-router-niche, domain-router-product, domain-router-security, domain-router-web-frontend
findings.suggestedFix: Add entries for the 9 domain-router agents in config.yaml under the agents section, or remove the orphaned .md files if they're not needed.

findings.description: The 'router' agent in config.yaml points to .claude/CLAUDE.md (not a file in .claude/agents/). This is technically valid but inconsistent with the pattern of other agents.
findings.evidence: router: path: .claude/CLAUDE.md — file exists but is the main CLAUDE.md, not an agent definition file.
findings.suggestedFix: Consider clarifying this is intentional with a comment, or create a dedicated .claude/agents/core/router.md.

findings.description: All model assignments use valid model names: haiku (3), opus (17), sonnet (92). Total: 112 model assignments for 111 agents (router has model in routing section too).
Tool manifest tracks Claude's built-in tools (22 core + 9 MCP = 31 total), not .claude/tools/ skill directories. The manifest is internally consistent and self-describing.
findings.evidence: Manifest lists 22 core tools (Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep, Task, Orchestrator, TaskCreate, TaskUpdate, TaskList, TaskGet, TaskOutput, TaskStop, Skill, AskUserQuestion, EnterPlanMode, ExitPlanMode, WebSearch, WebFetch, NotebookEdit, MemoryRecord) + 9 MCP tools. 491 skill tool directories exist on disk but are managed separately via skill-index.

findings.area: Agent Registry vs Config vs Disk
findings.description: Agent registry (119) matches disk files (119) but config.yaml only defines 111. The 9 domain-router agents on disk + registry are absent from config.yaml.
findings.evidence: Registry: 119 agents (metadata.totalAgents=119), Config: 111 agents, Disk: 119 .md files. The registry is in sync with disk but config.yaml is 8 behind.
findings.suggestedFix: Add the 9 domain-router agents to config.yaml to achieve full three-way sync.

findings.description: 16 broken require() paths found across .claude/hooks/ and .claude/lib/. 14 are in non-production lib modules (workers/, events/, db/, utils/), and 2 are intentional test fixtures in require-analyzer.cjs.
findings.evidence: Broken paths found in: archive-retention.cjs, worker-pool.cjs, dispatcher.cjs, collector.cjs, budget-enforcement.cjs, enforcement-defaults.cjs, path-constants.cjs, safe-rename.cjs, safe-path.cjs, require-analyzer.cjs (2 test fixtures), event-bus.cjs, event-types.cjs, sqlite-manager.cjs, queue-operations.cjs, server.cjs (a2a). All use absolute-style paths (e.g., '.claude/lib/utils/...') instead of relative paths.
findings.suggestedFix: These 14 files use paths like require('.claude/lib/utils/X') which resolve relative to CWD, not the file. Convert to proper relative require() paths (e.g., './X' or '../../lib/X').

findings.description: 4 utility modules contain require() calls to themselves in JSDoc comments/examples, not in executable code. These are documentation self-references, not runtime circular deps.
findings.evidence: hook-input.cjs (line 9, JSDoc example), safe-json.cjs (line 13, JSDoc example), atomic-write.cjs (line 17, JSDoc example), token-budget-tracker.cjs (line 8, JSDoc example). All are in comment blocks showing usage examples.
findings.suggestedFix: No fix needed — these are documentation patterns. However, the require-analysis regex should skip JSDoc blocks to avoid false positives.

findings.description: No real circular dependency chains found between routing/, memory/, or hooks<->lib boundaries. The 23 'cross-boundary cycles' initially detected were all false positives caused by the JSDoc self-reference pattern in hook-input.cjs and safe-json.cjs.
findings.evidence: Traced dependency graphs for 30+ hook files and all memory modules. All apparent cycles terminated at JSDoc self-references.

findings.description: 21 environment variables defined in .env.example are not referenced anywhere in .claude/ code. These may be dead configuration entries or consumed by external tools.
findings.evidence: Unreferenced vars: MCP_CONNECTION_NONBLOCKING, MCP_SERVER_CONNECTION_BATCH_SIZE, SMART_DEBUG_HITL, HEARTBEAT_AUTO_START, BASH_CWD_VALIDATOR, VARIABLE_QUOTING_VALIDATOR, ANTHROPIC_BETA, TASK_CLEANUP_RETENTION_MS, TASK_CLEANUP_INTERVAL_MS, TASK_CLEANUP_BATCH_SIZE, TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME, TELEGRAM_OWNER_USERNAME, TELEGRAM_CHAT_IDS, ARXIV_KEYWORDS, ARXIV_MAX_RESULTS, ARXIV_LOOKBACK_DAYS, EXA_MONITOR_TOPICS, EXA_MAX_RESULTS, EXA_AUTOPROMPT, ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW, TASK_GUARDRAIL_ENFORCEMENT
findings.suggestedFix: Audit each: remove truly dead vars from .env.example, or add code references if they're used by external scripts/tools not in .claude/.

findings.suggestedFix: Delete delegations.pid-614072.json if PID 614072 is no longer running. Add cleanup logic to session-end hooks.
